author.delta: ADR-001/002 и архитектура теперь требуют обработки ошибок трёх ветвей rollback cleanup и GetBucketVersioning перед каждым DELETE без кэша. Указаны тестовые файлы, runtime-права и unversioned bucket.
author.evidence: Текущие Decision/Confirmation в ADR-001/002, секция Ошибки и повторы архитектуры.

newRisks.assessment: Новая зависимость удаления от GetBucketVersioning требует отдельного IAM-права.
newRisks.evidence: ADR-002 и архитектура требуют право и явный отказ при недоступной проверке.

conditions.requirement: Preserve POST /scans responses during rollback-object cleanup failure. Explicitly plan adapting all three cleanup call sites to catch and log S3 removal failure, retaining 202 replay, 429 quota refusal and 503 DB failure, with orphan cleanup as retry safety net. Name regression tests for the three normal route branches.
conditions.evidence: apps/api/src/routes/scans.ts lines 231, 235 and 242 await storage.removeObject without catch. Existing store-original.ts removeObject swallows all failures. ADR-001 changes DeleteObject to propagate failures while architecture only asserts that business-layer best-effort handling exists. A failing S3 DELETE would currently escape those route branches and replace their established 202/429/503 responses.

verifications.evidence: Read current ADR-001 Decision/Confirmation and 05_architecture Ошибки и повторы. Both explicitly require all three POST /scans rollback branches to catch and log cleanup DELETE failure and preserve replay 202, quota refusal 429 and DB failure 503. ADR-001 names tests/unit/scans-cleanup.test.ts for all three responses. Reviewed ADR-002 and new versioning guard delta and author risk assessment: GetBucketVersioning runtime permission and unversioned target are explicit, errors remain visible. This verifies the corrected design artifacts only; implementation verification will occur in QE.
